dogecoin.text:
Remember when Tesla accepted Bitcoin and DOGE? Imagine what could happen if X Money brings crypto into the mix.

🔹 What does this mean for you?

- If crypto is integrated, demand could surge.
- Dogecoin holders may benefit the most.

Plus, a Visa partnership will allow seamless transfers from bank accounts and debit cards.

But here’s the real question… Will crypto be next?

Musk has a history of shaking up markets. If Dogecoin or another cryptocurrency gets integrated, we could see massive price action.
